summary: Implemented TASK-014: Convert Context to Brand Knowledge. Created a comprehensive brand asset management system with four main components: Brand Guidelines (logo, colors, typography, tone of voice, values), Asset Library (images, videos, templates with search and filtering), Style Guide (do/dont guidelines with categories), and Version History (tracking changes to brand guidelines). All components use Zustand for state management with localStorage persistence.
current_status: TASK-014 completed. Brand Knowledge feature fully implemented with all acceptance criteria met: brand guidelines storage, asset library, style guide reference, semantic search for assets, and version history.
